blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Face morphing attacks, in which the biometric traits of two or more identities are blended into a single face image, pose a severe threat to identity document issuance and automated border control. Consequently, a large body of work has proposed Single-image Morphing Attack Detection (S-MAD) algorithms and benchmarked them on datasets such as SYN-MAD22. However, the majority of these benchmarks operate exclusively in the digital domain, which contrasts with the real-world passport issuance pipeline in some countries, which still requires an applicant-supplied photograph to be printed and subsequently re-scanned before it is embedded in the identity document or fed into an automated verification system. This print-scan step introduces halftoning, resampling, color-space, and sensor noise that are absent from digital pipelines, and may mask the high-frequency artifacts that S-MAD models rely on. In this work, we introduce a print-scan version of the SYN-MAD22 dataset, obtained by printing and re-scanning all bona fide and morphed images at 300 and 600 DPI, and we use it to evaluate eight state-of-the-art S-MAD models trained exclusively on digital data. We additionally repeat the acquisition with a second scanner to assess cross-device robustness. Our results show that detectors that achieve near state-of-the-art performance in the digital domain suffer a more than threefold increase in average equal error rate, with the same qualitative degradation observed across both scanning devices, exposing a critical, previously under-reported gap between digital-benchmark performance and robustness to print-scan degradation.
blocks.zh: 脸部变形攻击将两个或两个以上身份的生物特征混入一个面相图像,对身份证件的签发和自动边境管制构成严重威胁。 因此,一大批工作都提出了单相模攻击检测(S-MAD)算法,并以SYN-MAD22等数据集作为基准。 然而,这些基准大多完全在数字领域运作,这与一些国家的现实世界护照发放管道形成对比,后者仍要求申请人提供的照片被打印并随后被重新扫描后才能被嵌入身份证件或输入自动核查系统. 这个平面扫描步骤引入了数字管所没有的半调子,再生,色相空间和传感器噪声,可能掩盖了S-MAD模型所依赖的高频文物. 在这项工作中,我们引入了SYN-MAD22数据集的打印扫描版,通过印刷和重新扫描300和600 DPI的所有善意和外形图像而获得,我们利用它来评价专门接受数字数据培训的8个最先进的S-MAD模型。 我们还用第二台扫描仪重复采购,以评估交叉设备的坚固性。 我们的结果显示,在数字领域实现近乎最先进性能的探测器平均等效出错率增加了三倍多,在两个扫描设备中都观察到同样的质量退化,暴露出数字基准性能与印刷扫描退化的强度之间的重要差距。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
In a morphing attack, the facial images of two or more individuals are digitally combined into a single image that is perceptually similar to both contributors, such that a face verification system or a human examiner may accept either individual as a match to the morphed image [ 10 ] . When such a morphed photograph is submitted during the application for an identity document (e.g., a passport), the resulting document can subsequently be used by any of the contributing accomplices to cross automated border control, enabling identity-sharing between a look-alike accomplice and a criminal who would otherwise not be able to obtain the document. This attack vector, commonly referred to as the morphing attack, has motivated a large and still growing body of work on Morphing Attack Detection (MAD), which is typically split into Single-image MAD (S-MAD), where only the document photograph is available, and Differential MAD (D-MAD), where a live capture of the presenting subject is additionally available for comparison [ 33 ] . The S-MAD setting is particularly relevant at the document-application stage, where the submitted photograph may need to be assessed before a trusted live reference image is available for differential comparison. As a result, a substantial research effort has gone into building S-MAD datasets and benchmarking detectors on them, most notably through the SYN-MAD 2022 [ 15 ] competition and dataset, which combines bona fide images with morphs generated by a wide range of morphing techniques, from landmark-based methods to GAN and diffusion-based approaches. Most of the existing S-MAD benchmarks, however, evaluate detectors directly on digital images, without accounting for transformations introduced by some document-application pipelines. This creates a potential domain shift in which the image presented to an S-MAD system is not the original digital image. In some passport application workflows, an applicant can submit a physical photograph that must satisfy quality requirements (e.g., ICAO 9303) [ 17 ] and the issuing authority subsequently scans this photograph for digital enrolment and storage. Thus, both bona fide images and potential morphing attacks undergo a physical print-scan (P&S) transformation before they reach an automated detector, meaning that evaluations conducted exclusively on the original digital images do not capture the acquisition domain encountered in such workflows.
The print-scan transformation is a lossy and multi-stage physical process in which printing quantizes color into a halftone pattern of ink dots, the paper substrate scatters light, and the sheet-fed scanner resamples the reflected light with its own sensor noise. Together, these effects induce an acquisition-domain shift between digital and P&S imagery, altering the low-level texture, edge, and color statistics on which S-MAD systems may rely. As illustrated in Figure 1 , these changes are spatially pronounced between the digital and print-scanned images, whereas the differences between the 300 and 600 DPI scans are comparatively small. Therefore, we argue that what remains missing is an open, paired and test-only benchmark on which current detectors can be compared reproducibly. Existing print-scan resources are private or sequestered [ 24 , 30 ] , and recent studies evaluate few detectors or focus on training-time mitigation [ 11 , 22 , 34 ] .

在变形攻击中,两个或两个以上个体的面部图像被数字化地组合成一个与两个贡献者在感知上相似的单一图像,这样面部核查系统或人检查者可以接受任何一个个体作为与变形图像的匹配[10]. 在申请身份证件(例如护照)期间提交这种变形照片时,由此产生的证件随后可以供任何提供协助的共犯使用,以跨越自动边境管制,使外貌相似的共犯与否则无法获得证件的罪犯分享身份。 这种攻击矢量,通常称为变形攻击,激发了大量仍在不断增长的关于粉碎攻击探测器(MAD)的工作,通常分为只有文件照片的单像MAD(S-MAD)和异形MAD(D-MAD)两个部分,另外还可以对呈现对象进行现场捕捉以进行比较[33]. 在文件应用阶段,S-MAD设置特别相关,在提供可信赖的现场参考图像进行差别比较之前,可能需要评估提交的照片。 因此,在建立S-MAD数据集和对其设定基准的探测器方面进行了大量研究,最显著的是通过SYN-MAD 2022[15]竞争和数据集,将真实的图像与从标志性方法到GAN和传播方法等多种形态技术产生的形态相结合。 然而,大多数现有的S-MAD基准直接在数字图像上评价探测器,而没有考虑到一些文件应用管道的转换。 这造成了潜在的域转移,其中呈现给S-MAD系统的图像不是原始的数字图像. 在一些护照申请工作流程中,申请人可以提交必须满足质量要求的实物照片(例如ICAO 9303)[17],签发当局随后扫描该照片进行数字注册和存储. 因此,善意图像和潜在形态攻击在到达自动探测器之前都要进行物理打印扫描(P&S)转换,这意味着完全根据原始数字图像进行的评价无法捕捉这些工作流程中遇到的获取领域。
打印扫描转换是一种失落的多阶段物理过程,在这种过程中,打印将颜色量化为墨水点的半色调图案,纸质底片散射光线,被页膜扫描仪用自己的感光噪声对反射光线进行重印. 这些效应共同导致数码和P&S图像之间的收购域转移,改变了S-MAD系统可能依赖的低层纹理、边缘和颜色统计。 如图1所示,数字扫描和打印扫描图像之间的空间变化比较明显,而300和600个DPI扫描之间的差别相对较小。 因此,我们认为,尚缺的是一个开放的、配对的和仅限试验的基准,可以对目前的探测器进行再作比较。 现有的打印扫描资源是私人资源或扣押[24、30],最近的研究评价了很少的探测器或侧重于培训时间减缓[11、22、34]。

blocks.en: In this paper, we address this gap by building a print-scan counterpart dataset of SYN-MAD22 [ 15 ] . We start by physically printing every bona fide and morphed image in the dataset and re-scanning it at two resolutions, 300 and 600 DPI, following a fixed, documented acquisition protocol. We then use this new dataset to benchmark eight state-of-the-art S-MAD systems, spanning classical texture and frequency-based methods and modern CNN and transformer-based detectors. We find that state-of-the-art detectors on digital SYN-MAD22 [ 15 ] images suffer a performance collapse once the print-scan transformation is applied, and that this degradation is largely insensitive to the specific scanning resolution used (300 vs. 600 DPI) but strongly modulated by the morphing algorithm.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们通过建立SYN-MAD22的打印扫描对应数据集来解决这一差距。 我们首先在数据集中实际打印每张真实和形态的图像,然后按照一份有文件记录的固定采购协议,在300和600 DPI这两项决议中重新扫描。 然后我们用这个新的数据集来衡量8个最先进的S-MAD系统,它们跨越古典纹理和频率方法以及现代CNN和变压器的探测器。 我们发现,数字SYN-MAD22[15]图像上最先进的探测器在应用打印扫描转换后会发生性能崩溃,这种降解在很大程度上对所使用的特定扫描分辨率(300 vs 600 DPI)不敏感,但被变形算法强调.

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce MAD22-PS , a paired print-scan extension of SYN-MAD22 comprising 5,687 source images (204 bona fide and 5,483 morphed), acquired using two scanners at 300 and 600 DPI. Designed as a test-only benchmark, it enables reproducible evaluation of cross-domain generalization across six morph-generation algorithms without training or fine-tuning on the benchmark. • We demonstrate a substantial generalization failure across eight S-MAD detectors from diverse methodological families: average EER increases from 11.00% on digital images to 41.85% after print-scanning. The degradation varies dramatically across detectors, with FD-MAD increasing from 5.10% to 77.51% EER, showing that strong digital-domain performance does not guarantee robustness to physical acquisition. • We show that degradation depends strongly on the morph-generation algorithm, whereas changing the scanning resolution from 300 to 600 DPI has little effect on average performance. We validate the overall degradation pattern using a second scanner and show that print-scanned morphs remain highly effective against four face-recognition systems, revealing that reduced detectability does not necessarily reduce attack effectiveness. The print-scanned dataset and our evaluation code will be publicly available upon acceptance, in order to support future research on print-scan–robust morphing attack detection.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Face Morphing Attacks. Face morphing attacks were first described by Ferrara et al. [ 10 ] , who showed that landmark-based morphing of two subjects’ face images could produce a single photograph that both contributors could use to pass automated and human face verification. Early morphing generation techniques relied on facial landmark detection, Delaunay triangulation, and alpha-blending [ 10 ] , and were later
complemented by generative approaches based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), such as MorGAN [ 6 ] and MIPGAN-I/II [ 38 ] , and, more recently, diffusion models [ 4 , 1 ] , which tend to produce morphs with fewer visible blending artifacts and higher perceptual quality. This diversity of generation mechanisms is important for MAD research, since detectors that overfit to the artifacts of a single morphing technique tend to generalize poorly to unseen morphing algorithms [ 33 ] .
blocks.zh:
脸部翻音 攻击。 面部形态攻击最早由Ferrara等人描述. [10],他们表明,两个主体的脸像的划时代形态可以产生一张照片,两个贡献者都可以用来通过自动和人脸验证. 早期的形态生成技术依赖于面部标志性检测,Delaunay三角化,和α-混合[10],后来是
辅之以基于基因芳香网络(GANs)的遗传学方法,如MorGAN [6]和MIPGAN-I/II [38],以及最近的传播模型[4,1],这些模型往往产生外形,可见混合文物较少,视觉质量更高. 这种多样的生成机制对于MAD研究很重要,因为对单一形态学技术的文物过于适应的探测器往往一般化不良到看不见的形态学算法[33].

blocks.en: Morphing Attack Detection. S-MAD methods must determine whether a single image is a morph due to statistical artifacts left by the generation process, such as ghosting or frequency-domain inconsistencies. Proposed S-MAD approaches range from hand-crafted texture descriptors (e.g., LBP, BSIF) combined with classical classifiers, to deep CNN architectures such as MixFaceNet-MAD and Inception-MAD [ 5 ] and identity-disentanglement approaches [ 23 ] , to more recent foundation-model-based detectors [ 3 ] , self-supervised approaches [ 18 , 19 ] , and approaches that explicitly analyze the image in the frequency domain to detect blending artifacts [ 26 , 27 ] . The SYN-MAD 2022 competition [ 15 ] fostered much of this progress by providing a common and large-scale benchmark consisting of bona fide images and morphs produced with a wide variety of morphing algorithms, and by ranking a large number of submitted S-MAD solutions under a standardized protocol. We build directly on this dataset in the present work.
blocks.zh: 粉碎攻击探测器。 S-MAD方法必须确定单个图像是否由于生成过程留下的统计文物而成为形态,如幽灵或频率域不一致. 拟议的S-MAD方法从手动纹理描述器(如LBP,BSIF)与古典分类器相结合,到深层CNN架构,如MixFaceNet-MAD和Inception-MAD[5]和身份分离方法[23],到更近的基于基础模型的探测器[3],自我监督的方法[18,19],以及明确分析频率域中图像以探测混合文物的方法[26,27]. SYN-MAD 2022竞争[15]促进了这一进展的很大一部分,提供了一个由各种形态算法产生的善意图像和形态组成的共同和大规模基准,并根据标准化协议对大量提交的S-MAD解决方案进行了排名。 我们直接利用目前工作中的这一数据集。

blocks.en: Print-Scan Effects on MAD. Prior work has established that print-scan acquisition affects both the vulnerability of face-recognition (FR) systems to morphing attacks and the performance of MAD. Early studies showed that print-scanning harms single-image detection while morphs can still deceive FR after re-digitization [ 32 , 29 ] . Large evaluations such as NIST FRVT MORPH [ 24 ] , which reported very high false-detection rates on print-scanned bona fide images for most submitted algorithms, and the SOTAMD/FVC-onGoing platform [ 30 ] added print-scanned conditions for S-MAD and D-MAD. Later work largely moved to mitigation, either by training with simulated print-scan data [ 11 , 34 , 35 ] , which improves robustness, or by proposing ViT [ 9 ] and CLIP-based [ 28 ] detectors tested on digital, print-scanned and compressed variants [ 37 , 25 ] . Table I compares the closest works. The nearest to ours is Neddo et al. [ 22 ] , who print-scan three datasets and analyze mixed digital/print-scan pairings for three FR systems and one S-MAD network that they train themselves. We instead keep the subjects, morph pairs and protocol of the established SYN-MAD22 benchmark [ 15 ] fixed, and evaluate eight off-the-shelf detectors from different families on its paired print-scanned counterpart, using two scanners, two resolutions, six morph generators (including diffusion morphs) and four FR systems. To the best of our knowledge, MAD22-PS is also the only one of these resources that is publicly released. The NIST and SOTAMD print-scan data are sequestered and accessible only through algorithm submission, which prevents score-level analysis and reproducible comparison. By design, MAD22-PS is a test-only benchmark for cross-domain generalization, so print-scan-aware training and mixed pairings are complementary and out of its scope.
blocks.zh: 打印扫描效果对MAD. 先前的工作已经确定,印刷扫描器的获取既影响面部识别系统对形态攻击的脆弱性,也影响MAD的性能。 早期的研究表明,打印扫描会伤害单像检测,而形态在重新数字化后仍然可以欺骗FR[32,29]. 大型评价如NIST FRVT MORPH[24],报告大多数提交的算法在打印扫描善意图像上的虚假检测率非常高,SOTAMD/FVC-on Going平台[30]增加了S-MAD和D-MAD的打印扫描条件. 后来的工作基本转移到缓解方面,要么是通过使用模拟打印扫描数据[11、34、35]的培训,提高稳健性,要么通过数字、打印扫描和压缩变体测试的VIT[9]和CLIP[28]探测器。 图表 我比较最接近的作品。 离我们最近的是Neddo等人[22],他打印了三套数据集,并分析了三个FR系统和一个S-MAD网络的混合数字/打印-扫描配对,他们自己培训。 相反,我们保留既定SYN-MAD22基准的标的、形态配对和协议[15],并用两台扫描仪、两台分辨率、六台形态发电机(包括扩散形态)和四台FR系统对来自不同家庭的8台现成探测器进行对比扫描。 据我们所知,MAD22-PS也是其中唯一公开发布的资源. NIST和SOTAMD的打印扫描数据只能通过算法提交进行封存和获取,这阻碍了分数级分析和可复制的比较. 从设计上看,MAD22-PS是跨域通用的测试唯一的基准,所以印刷-扫描-意识训练和混合配对是互补的,超出了其范围.

blocks.en:
Robustness of Biometric Systems to Real-World Degradations. More broadly, a parallel and growing line of work has shown that biometric recognition and
detection systems, when evaluated only on curated and clean benchmark data, overestimate the accuracy that can be expected under real-world acquisition conditions. In face recognition, occlusions such as masks, sunglasses, and scarves have been shown to disproportionately harm accuracy and, more importantly, to do so unequally across demographic groups, exacerbating existing fairness gaps [ 20 ] . Similarly, in [ 36 ] it was shown that the presence of dark sunglasses in a probe image degrades one-to-many facial identification accuracy by an amount comparable to severe Gaussian blur or a substantial reduction in image resolution, and that this degradation compounds when sunglasses are combined with other quality factors. Our work is directly motivated by this broader body of work on the fragility of biometric systems to distribution shifts and extends the specific print-scan MAD literature along the axes of dataset scale, resolution comparison, detector recency, and joint MAD/FR-vulnerability analysis.

blocks.en: III Print-Scanned SYN-MAD22 Dataset
blocks.zh: 三. 打印扫描的SYN-MAD22数据集

blocks.en: MAD22-PS is a physical printed and scanned extension of the SYN-MAD22 benchmark [ 15 ] , designed to preserve its underlying subjects, bona fide samples, and morph-generation methods while introducing controlled physical acquisition conditions. Our dataset contains the original digital images together with corresponding print-scanned versions acquired at 300 and 600 DPI and satisfies ICAO passport-photo compliance constraints. From SYN-MAD22, MAD22-PS contains 204 bona fide images and 5,483 morphed images generated using OpenCV, FaceMorpher, WebMorph, MIPGAN-I, MIPGAN-II [ 38 ] and MorDIFF [ 4 ] , comprising a total of 5,687 images.

blocks.en: III-C Availability and Licensing
blocks.zh: 三-C 提供和许可证发放

blocks.en: MAD22-PS is derived from the MAD22 benchmark of SYN-MAD 2022 [ 15 ] , whose bona fide images come from the Face Research Lab London (FRLL) set [ 31 ] . FRLL is released under the CC BY 4.0 license, and its participants consented to their images being used in research. Our acquisition only re-digitizes existing images (print and scan) and involves no new human subjects, so no additional identities or personal data are introduced. Therefore, access to the digital morph images follows the MAD22 request procedure, and we distribute only the print-scanned version respecting the applicable source-dataset terms. The print-scanned dataset and our evaluation code will be publicly available upon acceptance, in order to support future research on print-scan–robust morphing attack detection.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 四. 实验设计

blocks.en: IV-A Research Questions
blocks.zh: 研究问题

blocks.en:
Our evaluation is designed to answer three questions: (RQ1) How
much does print-scanning degrade the accuracy of state-of-the-art S-MAD
detectors relative to their digital-domain performance? (RQ2) Does
this degradation depend on the scanning resolution (300 vs. 600 DPI)? (RQ3) Does the degradation depend on the morphing algorithm used
to generate the attack image, i.e., are morphs produced by some generation
techniques inherently more (or less) robust to print-scanning than others,
and does this degradation in detection accuracy translate into a corresponding drop in attack effectiveness against face recognition systems?

blocks.en: IV-B S-MAD Models
blocks.zh: IV-B S-MAD 模型

blocks.en: We evaluate a panel of eight S-MAD models, selected to be representative of the main families of approaches in the current literature. We use MixFaceNet-MAD [ 5 ] and Inception-MAD [ 5 ] , which are two lightweight CNN-based detectors, OrthoMAD [ 23 ] , a ResNet-18-based detector that learns to disentangle the two contributing identities into orthogonal latent vectors, PCA-MAD, a classical baseline that performs morph detection on a PCA-reduced texture representation of the face image, MADation (ViT-B) and MADation (ViT-L) [ 3 ] , foundation-model-based detectors that adapt a CLIP [ 28 ] vision encoder with LoRA [ 12 ] weights, FD-MAD [ 26 ] , a lightweight, interpretable detector based on residual Fourier-domain features extracted from different facial regions and SelfMAD++ [ 19 ] , a self-supervised foundation-model-based detector that learns to detect generic morphing artifacts simulated during training. Where possible, we use publicly available pre-trained weights to avoid introducing confounds from re-training. Furthermore, all detectors are trained exclusively on digital data (SMDD), so that none of them has ever observed a print-scanned image during training. This is a deliberate design choice since our goal is to measure the out-of-domain performance of existing digitally trained S-MAD models when evaluated without adaptation on MAD22-PS, not the accuracy that could be recovered by retraining on print-scanned data (which we discuss as a mitigation strategy in Section VI ). Training on MAD22-PS would turn this into an in-domain evaluation and make results across methods incomparable. We therefore release the set with a fixed protocol (no training, fine-tuning or threshold selection on MAD22-PS) and recommend that print-scan-robust detectors be trained on separate print-scanned or simulated data [ 34 , 35 , 11 ] and then evaluated on MAD22-PS.

blocks.en: IV-C Evaluation Protocol and Metrics
blocks.zh: IV-C 评价议定书和计量

blocks.en: Following standard practice in the MAD literature and the ISO/IEC 30107-3 [ 16 ] presentation attack detection standard, we report Equal Error Rate (EER), which corresponds to the operating point at which APCER equals BPCER. Additionally, we report the Mated Morph Presentation Match Rate (MMPMR), which measures the proportion of mated morph comparisons that are accepted by a face recognition system at a specified decision threshold. We report MMPMR at false match rate (FMR) operating points of 1 % 1\% and 0.1 % 0.1\% in Table V . The corresponding model-specific thresholds are estimated on LFW [ 13 ] , following the SYN-MAD 2022 protocol [ 15 ] , and are applied unchanged to all acquisition conditions. For each detector, morphing algorithm, and acquisition condition, we obtain EER directly from the corresponding evaluation scores by sweeping the decision threshold and identifying the operating point at which APCER and BPCER are equal. We use EER as a threshold-independent summary of the separability between bona fide and morphed score distributions, instead of using a fixed operational decision threshold.
blocks.zh: 按照MAD文献中的标准惯例和ISO/IEC 30107-3[16]演示攻击检测标准,我们报告等效误差率(EER),与APCER等于BPCER的操作点相对应. 此外,我们报告配制的摩尔夫表征比率(MMPMR),它测量配制形态比较的比例,这些比较被面部识别系统在规定的决定阈值接受. 我们在表五中以1%的比对率和0.1%的比对率报告MMPMR。 相应的模型特定阈值按照SYN-MAD 2022协议在LFW [13] 上估算,并对所有获取条件适用不变. 对于每个探测器,形态算法和获取条件,我们通过扫清决定阈值和确定APCER和BPCER相等的操作点,直接从相应的评价分数中获得ER. 我们使用EER作为善意和形态分数分配之间可分离性的阈值独立总结,而不是使用固定的业务决定阈值.

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: In order to quantify the impact of print–scan acquisition, we organize the results around the three research questions. RQ1 examines the overall degradation of S-MAD accuracy relative to the original digital condition. RQ2 investigates whether this degradation is affected by the scanning resolution, comparing 300 and 600 DPI. RQ3 analyzes the importance of the morph-generation algorithm and examines whether reduced morph detectability is accompanied by a corresponding reduction in the effectiveness of the attacks against downstream face recognition systems. We first report the EER results for the eight S-MAD models and subsequently analyze the MMPMR results for four face recognition models. Unless stated otherwise, the digital condition denotes the original SYN-MAD22 [ 15 ] images, whereas PS300 and PS600 denote the corresponding images after printing and re-scanning at 300 and 600 DPI, respectively.

blocks.en: V-A RQ1: Overall Impact of Print-Scanning
blocks.zh: V-A RQ1:打印扫描的总体影响

blocks.en:
Table III reports the EER of eight S-MAD models in the digital domain and after print-scan acquisition at 600 and 300 DPI, respectively. Averaged across all eight detectors and six morphing algorithms, EER rises from 11.00% in the digital domain to 41.85% at 600 DPI and 41.72% at 300 DPI, which represents more than a threefold relative increase (+280% and +279%, respectively) and indicates that digital-domain performance does not transfer reliably to print-scanned images. Every single detector in our analysis exhibits an increase in EER under print-scanning, without exception. The smallest degradation is observed for SelfMAD++ [ 19 ] , whose EER increases from 1.06% to 7.27% (PS600) / 8.41% (PS300), which represents a six to eightfold relative increase. The largest, and most concerning, degradation is observed for FD-MAD [ 26 ] , whose EER increases from 5.10%, the second-best digital result in our analysis, to 77.51% (PS600) / 75.58% (PS300). These results indicate a domain shift and a catastrophic failure when the digitally trained
detector is tested on print-scanned images. The sensitivity of FD-MAD is consistent with its reliance
on residual Fourier-domain features extracted from different facial regions, and the printing halftone process, together with the scanner’s own resampling and anti-aliasing filtering, constitutes a strong and highly structured perturbation of exactly the mid-to-high spatial frequencies that such detectors exploit. This confirms our hypothesis that print-scanning degrades the accuracy of state-of-the-art S-MAD models and shows that strong digital-domain performance is not just imperfect, but potentially misleading, as a predictor of print-scan robustness.

blocks.en: V-B RQ2: Effect of Scanning Resolution
blocks.zh: V-B RQ2:扫描分辨率的效果

blocks.en: Comparing the PS600 and PS300 columns of Table III shows that scanning resolution has, at best, a second-order effect on S-MAD accuracy: the panel-averaged EER differs by only 0.13 percentage points between 600 DPI (41.85%) and 300 DPI (41.72%), and four out of eight detectors are, in fact, marginally more accurate at 300 DPI than at 600 DPI (e.g., MixFaceNet-MAD: 36.83% at PS600 vs. 31.21% at PS300). This indicates that the dominant source of degradation is not the resolution at which the scanner samples the printed photograph, but rather the printing or scanning step itself, which contains factors such as halftoning, dot gain, and paper-substrate light scattering, together with lower-level color and contrast transformations that are common to both DPI settings. Within the evaluated acquisition setup, increasing the scanning resolution from 300 to 600 DPI does not meaningfully improve average S-MAD performance. This suggests that scanning resolution alone is insufficient to address the observed print-scan domain shift.
blocks.zh: 比较表三的PS600和PS300列显示,扫描分辨率最多只能对S-MAD的准确性产生二等影响:面板平均ER在600 DPI(41.85%)和300 DPI(41.72%)之间只差0.13个百分点,事实上,8个探测器中有4个在300 DPI比600 DPI(例如MixFaceNet-MAD:36.83%在PS600对31.21%在PS300)更准确。 这表明主要的降解源不是扫描仪对打印的照片进行采样的分辨率,而是打印或扫描步骤本身,其中包含半调谐,点增益,纸质底光散射等因素,以及两种DPI设置中常见的较低层次的颜色和对比变换. 在经过评价的购置结构中,扫描分辨率从300个增加到600个DPI并不能真正改善平均S-MAD的性能。 这表明,仅扫描分辨率不足以解决所观察到的打印扫描域转移。

blocks.en: Cross-scanner robustness. To examine whether the observed degradation is specific to the scanner used in the primary acquisition, we repeated the evaluation using a second scanning device, the Konica Minolta bizhub C450i. As summarized in Table IV , the increase in average EER relative to the digital condition is observed with both scanners at both resolutions. Although the precise EER values vary between devices, the dominant performance loss is associated with print–scan acquisition rather than with a particular scanner or DPI setting. The complete per-detector and per-morphing-algorithm results for the C450i are reported in the supplementary material (Table 1).
blocks.zh: 跨扫描器坚固. 为了检查所观察到的降解是否是主要购置时使用的扫描仪所特有的,我们用第二个扫描设备——Konica Minolta bizhub C450i——重复了评估。 如表四所概述,在两项决议中,均用扫描仪观测到与数字条件相比的平均ER增加。 虽然设备之间的精确ER值不同,但最主要的性能损失与打印-扫描获取有关,而不是与特定的扫描器或DPI设置有关. 补充材料中报告了C450i的每个探测器和每个形态的算术结果(表1)。

blocks.en: V-C RQ3: Effect of the Morphing Algorithm
blocks.zh: V-C RQ3:解析算法的影响

blocks.en: Table III additionally breaks results down by morphing generation algorithm, averaged across detectors, and we observe that two patterns emerge. First, the digital-domain difficulty of each algorithm is not preserved under print-scanning; that is, morphs produced by FaceMorpher, which are almost perfectly detected in the digital domain (0.70% EER), become substantially harder to detect once printed and scanned (25.90% at PS600 / 24.12% at PS300). This represents more than a 30-fold relative increase. Second, representation-level morphs exhibit a higher degradation under print-scanning. Most notably, MorDIFF [ 4 ] increases from 5.78% EER in the digital domain to 60.73% at PS600 and 61.29% at PS300, representing more than a tenfold relative increase and the highest average print-scan EER among the evaluated morphing algorithms. MIPGAN-I and MIPGAN-II [ 38 ] similarly exceed 50% EER after print-scanning, which indicates that the digital-domain detectability of representation-level morphs does not necessarily transfer to the physical acquisition domain. The nearly identical MorDIFF results at 300 and 600 DPI further support the RQ2 observation that scanning resolution has a comparatively limited effect. For the GAN-based morphs, we attribute this effect to the domain shift and to the fact that GAN-generated morphs already minimize the low-level pixel-domain blending artifacts (ghosting, double edges) that some detectors exploit. Print-scanning additionally modifies residual texture and frequency information through halftoning, resampling, and scanner processing. In contrast, image level/landmark-based morphs remain comparatively more detectable after print-scanning, but still suffer large relative degradations across every detector in our analysis.

MIPGAN-I和MIPGAN-II [38]在打印扫描后同样超过50%的EER,这表明代表级形态的数字域可探测性并不一定会转移到物理获取域. 几乎相同的MORDIFF结果为300和600 DPI进一步支持RQ2的观察,即扫描分辨率的效果相对有限. 对于基于GAN的形态,我们将此效应归因于域位移,以及GAN产生的形态已经将一些探测器利用的低水平像素域混合文物(鬼魂,双边缘)降到最低. 印刷扫描法通过半调压、再取样和扫描处理,进一步修改残余纹理和频率信息。 相比之下,在打印扫描后,基于图像水平/地标的形态仍然比较容易被探测,但在我们的分析中,每个探测器仍然受到较大的相对退化。

blocks.en: V-D Attack Success vs. Detection Failure
blocks.zh: V-D 攻击成功与检测失败

blocks.en: Beyond MAD accuracy, Table V reports the MMPMR, the standard metric for the effectiveness of a morph as an attack against a face recognition system (FRs). This metric was reported for four modern FR models, namely CurricularFace [ 14 ] , ElasticFace [ 2 ] , MagFace [ 21 ] , and ArcFace [ 8 ] . For each FR model, the similarity-score thresholds corresponding to the FMR operating points of 1 % 1\% and 0.1 % 0.1\% are estimated on the LFW benchmark [ 13 ] , following the evaluation protocol of SYN-MAD 2022 [ 15 ] .

blocks.en: Overall, morphing attacks remain highly effective and sometimes even obtain higher MMPMR values (e.g., FaceMorpher with MMPMR100 of 0.962 at Digital vs. 0.972 at PS300) after print-scanning. A possible explanation is that the print–scan process could act as a smoothing and resampling transformation that attenuates fine and high-frequency morphing artifacts while preserving much of the low and mid-frequency facial structure associated with identity. Since S-MAD methods often depend on these fine artifacts, their accuracy decreases. In contrast, face recognition models can remain sensitive to the coarser identity information shared by the morph and its contributors. The suppression of unnatural local details may even make the morph representation more compatible with both identities, leading to slightly higher MMPMR values. Hence, print-scanning can make morphs harder to detect without making them less effective against the downstream face recognition system. Additionally, we report the FR-vulnerability evaluation using the C450i scanner in the supplementary material (Table 2), and we observe that morphs remain highly effective against the evaluated FR systems after print-scanning.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,形态攻击仍然非常有效,有时甚至获得更高的MMPMR值(如FaceMorpher在Digital vs. 0.972 at PS300)在打印扫描后获得0.962的MMMR100. 一种可能的解释是,打印扫描工艺可以起到平滑和再生的转化作用,削弱精细的高频变形文物,同时保留与身份相关的大部分低频和中频面部结构。 由于S-MAD方法往往依赖于这些精细的文物,因此其准确性下降. 相比之下,脸部识别模型可以保持对形态及其贡献者共享的较短身份信息的敏感性. 压制非自然的局部细节甚至可能使形态性表现更符合两种特征,导致MMPMR值略高. 因此,打印扫描可以使形态变形更难检测,而不会降低其对抗下游面识别系统的效果. 此外,我们利用C450i扫描仪在补充材料中报告FR-挥发性评价(表2),我们观察到,在打印扫描后,形态仍然对评估的FR系统非常有效。

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our results indicate that the strong performance reported for S-MAD methods on digital benchmarks such as SYN-MAD22 does not transfer to the MAD22-PS test conditions. Based on this, we identify three implications for S-MAD evaluation. First, performance on digital benchmarks should not be assumed to transfer to print-scanned images. Evaluations should therefore report performance on print-scanned test data alongside digital test performance. For instance, NIST’s own FRVT MORPH evaluation [ 24 ] reached a similar conclusion using a different dataset and detector pool, and our results show that this concern remains unresolved for a substantially more recent generation of S-MAD algorithms. Second, our per-resolution results (RQ2) show that increasing the scanning DPI is, on its own, an ineffective mitigation since this degradation is driven predominantly by the printing or scanning step, not by scanner sampling fidelity. This conclusion is further supported by the cross-scanner experiment, which shows that although the precise degradation varies between the C250i and C450i, both devices exhibit a loss of S-MAD accuracy relative to the digital condition, which indicates that the observed domain shift is not specific to a single scanner. Third, print-scanning degrades S-MAD performance while preserving the effectiveness of the morphing attacks against downstream FR systems. Hence, under the MAD22-PS test conditions, the attacks become harder to detect without becoming less effective against face recognition systems. We also note that the direction of the print-scan-induced error is not consistent across the literature; for instance, NIST [ 24 ] observed predominantly elevated false-detection rates on bona fide images, whereas our worst-affected detector, FD-MAD [ 26 ] , instead misses morphs at an elevated rate. This suggests that print-scan robustness cannot be assumed to fail ”safely” (i.e., towards flagging more images for manual review) and must be empirically verified per detector instead of inferring from the failure mode of a single prior evaluation. Based on these findings, we point to two complementary directions for closing this gap. The first is data-centric, that is, augmenting S-MAD training sets with print-scanned (or simulated print-scan) samples, in the same spirit as in [ 34 , 35 ] , where synthetic print-scan texture transfer is used for MAD training, and as prior work that recovered part of the accuracy lost to sunglasses occlusion in face recognition by augmenting the gallery/training set with the degradation itself [ 36 ] . Furthermore, our finding that SelfMAD++ [ 19 ] , whose training procedure already relies on simulating generic morphing artifacts instead of memorizing algorithm-specific traces, degrades less than the other seven detectors (RQ1) is encouraging initial evidence that artifact-simulation-based training may transfer some robustness to the print-scan domain even without ever observing a real print-scanned image, and, combined with the results presented in [ 34 ] , suggests that explicitly incorporating a print-scan simulation module into the artifact-simulation pipeline could close much of the remaining gap. The second direction is model-centric, that is, designing detectors or explicit print-scan simulation modules that are invariant to halftoning and re-sampling noise, while remaining sensitive to genuine morphing artifacts. This is a harder objective, since, as we show in Section V , the print-scan process appears to remove or mask exactly the kind of signals that S-MAD systems rely on most heavily.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,所报告的S-MAD方法在SYN-MAD22等数字基准上的强性能并没有转移到MAD22-PS测试条件上. 在此基础上,我们确定了对S-MAD评价的三个影响。 首先,不应假定数字基准方面的业绩将转移到打印扫描图像。 因此,评价应连同数字测试性能一起报告打印扫描测试数据的业绩。 例如,NIST自己的FRVT MORPH评价[24]利用不同的数据集和探测器库得出了类似的结论,我们的结果表明,对于相当近代的S-MAD算法来说,这一关切仍未得到解决。 第二,我们的每个分辨率结果(RQ2)表明,增加扫描DPI本身就是一种无效的缓解,因为这种退化主要是由打印或扫描步骤驱动的,而不是由扫描仪取样忠诚度驱动的。 这一结论进一步得到跨扫描器实验的支持,该实验显示,虽然C250i和C450i的精确降解程度不同,但这两个设备都显示出相对于数字条件的S-MAD精度损失,这表明观测到的域位移并不是针对单个扫描仪的. 第三,打印扫描会降低S-MAD的性能,同时保持对下游FR系统的形态攻击的有效性. 因此,在MAD22-PS测试条件下,攻击变得难以侦测,而不会对面部识别系统失去效力。 我们还注意到,印刷扫描引起的错误的方向在文献中并不一致;例如,NIST [24] 观察到善意图像上的假探测率主要较高,而我们受影响最严重的探测器FD-MAD [26]却错失了高速的形态。 这表明印刷扫描强度不能被假定为“安全地”失败(即朝向标出更多图像供人工审查的方向),必须逐个探测器进行经验验证,而不是从一次前评价的失败模式推断出来。 根据这些调查结果,我们指出缩小这一差距的两个相辅相成的方向。 首先是以数据为中心,即用打印扫描(或模拟打印扫描)样品加强S-MAD的成套培训,其精神与[34,35]相同,其中合成打印扫描纹理转移用于MAD培训,并作为先前的工作,恢复了遮阳镜在识别面前丢失的部分精度,办法是用降解本身来扩大画廊/培训集[36]。 此外,我们发现,SelfMAD++ [19] 的培训程序已经依靠仿真通用的变形文物,而不是对算法特定痕迹的记忆,其降解程度低于其他7个探测器(RQ1),这是令人鼓舞的初步证据,表明以仿真技术为基础的培训即使从未观测过真正的打印扫描图像,也可能将一些坚固性转移到打印扫描领域,而且结合[34] 提出的结果,表明将打印扫描模拟模块明确纳入仿真工艺的管道中,可以缩小大部分剩余差距。 第二个方向以模型为中心,即设计探测器或显式的打印扫描模拟模块,这些模块对半振荡和重采样噪声不具有变异性,同时对真正的形态文物保持敏感. 这是一个更困难的目标,因为我们在第五节中显示,打印扫描过程似乎完全删除或掩盖了S-MAD系统最依赖的那种信号。

blocks.en:
Limitations. Although our study is based on two different scanners with two DPI settings, it uses a single printer (Xerox PrimeLink C9065). Therefore, different hardware or paper stocks could produce different degradation profiles, and due to this, we encourage future work to broaden this hardware coverage. Furthermore, since the evaluation protocol deliberately excludes training or fine-tuning on MAD22-PS, our results quantify the generalization of
digitally trained detectors instead of the performance achievable
through print-scan-aware adaptation. Investigating such adaptation
strategies remains an important direction for future work.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: We introduced MAD22-PS, a print-scanned extension of SYN-MAD22 [ 15 ] at 300 and 600 DPI, and evaluated eight state-of-the-art S-MAD systems. Average EER increased from 11.00% on digital images to approximately 42.00% after print-scanning, with especially severe failures for the frequency-domain method. The degradation was largely insensitive to scanning resolution but varied more across morphing algorithms. At the same time, morphs remained highly effective against the evaluated face recognition systems, showing that print-scanning can make attacks harder to detect without reducing their effectiveness. These results demonstrate that digital-only benchmarks can substantially overestimate operational robustness. We release MAD22-PS and the evaluation protocol to support the development of print-scan–robust S-MAD systems.
blocks.zh: 我们引进了MAD22-PS,这是SYN-MAD22[15]在300和600 DPI的打印扫描扩展,并评价了8个最先进的S-MAD系统. 平均EER从数字图像的11.00%增加到打印扫描后的大约42.00%,频率域法的故障尤其严重. 降解在很大程度上对扫描分辨率不敏感,但形态算法差异更大。 同时,形态相对于被评价的面部识别系统仍然非常有效,表明打印扫描可以使攻击更难探测,而不会降低其有效性. 这些结果表明,只有数字化的基准可以大大高估业务稳健性。 我们发布了MAD22-PS和评价协议,以支持打印-扫描-robust S-MAD系统的开发.
